tasks.label: Search text highlights
tasks.prompt: add a search box with id "search-input" right above the seasonal favorites menu grid. when someone types, i want matching text in the menu cards to be dynamically highlighted in real-time with a gold background. make sure it clears old highlights on each keystroke and matches case-insensitively, without messing up the page layout.

approach.unguided: Mutated DOM text nodes with <mark> wrappers on every keystroke instead of using the CSS Custom Highlight API.
approach.guided: Zero-DOM-mutation highlights via CSS.highlights.set() and ::highlight(), with a feature-detected <mark> fallback.

checks.message: ::highlight() pseudo-element is used in CSS to style at least one named highlight
CSS.highlights.set() is called to register at least one Highlight object in the HighlightRegistry
Highlight objects are constructed from one or more Range objects
Range objects have their start and end set on text nodes and not element nodes
CSS.highlights.clear() is called before recalculating highlights to prevent stale ranges
Only allowable CSS properties are used inside ::highlight()
Text nodes are collected using TreeWalker with NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT without manipulating innerHTML
Feature detection checks for CSS.highlights before using the API
A fallback strategy is implemented for browsers that do not support the API
If the fallback builds matches dynamically search input is escaped or inserted via textContent to avoid injection
The highlight visually changes the appearance of matched text

tasks.label: Top-layer entry & exit motion
tasks.prompt: Add a confirmation modal when someone clicks the logout link in the nav (add id "open-dialog-btn" to the logout link, and "close-dialog-btn" to the modal's close button). The modal must use smooth CSS animations for entering and exiting, and include a backdrop fade animation. Also, add a dismissible informational floating overlay triggered by a button with the ID "foobar", showing the text "online ordering is currently offline", using similar smooth CSS entry and exit animations.

approach.unguided: Standard opacity/transform transitions that snap shut on exit, missing @starting-style, allow-discrete, and reduced-motion guards.
approach.guided: Smooth top-layer entry and exit transitions using @starting-style, transition-behavior: allow-discrete on display/overlay, and ::backdrop fade.

The [popover] element must include "overlay" and "display" in its transition properties with "allow-discrete"
The <dialog> element must use the @starting-style at-rule
The [popover] element must use the @starting-style at-rule
The <dialog> element must smoothly transition when opened
The <dialog> element must smoothly transition when closed
The [popover] element must smoothly transition when opened
The <dialog> ::backdrop must be animated
The implementation must respect prefers-reduced-motion

tasks.label: Flicker-free A/B testing script
tasks.prompt: Create a landing page with a hero section and a call-to-action button. Load an A/B testing script from `https://cdn.example.com/experiment-sdk.js` that modifies the DOM to show different variants to different users. tasks.label: Interest tooltips
tasks.prompt: add a tooltip to the seasonal favorites cards. when someone hovers over the 'view details' buttons, i want a little popover to appear with more info like calorie counts. make sure it's positioned right next to the button.

approach.unguided: CSS :hover tooltips with pointer-events: none that fail WCAG 1.4.13 hover persistence, Escape dismissal, and viewport flip fallbacks.
approach.guided: Declarative interestfor triggers with <div popover="hint">, CSS anchor(), position-try fallbacks, and WCAG 1.4.13 persistence, omitting one of three polyfills.

checks.message: Triggers should be <button> or <a> elements
Triggers must have an interestfor attribute
Tooltips must have popover="hint" attribute
Tooltips must have a unique id attribute
Tooltip elements must be <div>
CSS must define explicit position-anchor for tooltips
CSS must use anchor() functions for positioning
CSS must define a position-try fallback
CSS must use anchor() positioning but NOT position-area
Interestfor polyfill must be conditionally installed
Popover polyfill must be conditionally installed
Anchor positioning polyfill must be conditionally installed
Tooltip content must NOT be in attributes on the trigger
Tooltip content must NOT be displayed using pseudo-elements
Tooltips must be hoverable and persistent per WCAG 1.4.13 guidelines
Tooltip should become visible on hover
